page: Microsoft Azure EC48ads_v5 is an ECADSv5-family virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by AMD processors. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This resource density positions the server within the memory-optimized category, designed to handle workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without necessitating GPU acceleration.

The server is equipped with 1843 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or onboard GPU hardware. The combination of dedicated CPU allocation, large memory capacity, and local SSD storage makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and enterprise workloads that benefit from fast local temporary storage and high memory-to-vCPU ratios.
